title: Nail salon, existing leased storefront, no construction — Manatí, FEMA AE
description: We are opening a nail salon in an existing leased storefront in Manatí. Licensed nail technicians will do manicures and pedicures. No construction; we only bring in chairs and stations.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009).
RULE_0020: employees -> CFSE workers' compensation policy.
RULE_0714: BT_NAIL_SALON -> Junta Examinadora de Especialistas en Belleza license (Ley 9-1972, 10 LPRA 2123-2125, Art. 15).

mustNotInclude.rationale: RULE_0157 records that no statute requiring a Salud sanitary license for nail salons was identified; PS 971 (2026) would create one but is not law. So it may show as needs-more-information but must never be REQUIRED.
Pin is in the SFHA but there is no construction/site work: RULE_0706 any_of requires a construction-type project fact.
No alcohol: RULE_0013/0014 need Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / Q_ALCOHOL_SERVED; business-type alcohol rules exist only for Bar / Juice Bar.
No food preparation: RULE_0010 needs Q_FOOD_PREPARED.
No construction stated: RULE_0643-0646 need a construction / renovation project type or structural work.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm.
No SREP land and no change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-14 by the scenario loop: first nail salon and first Manatí scenario (FEMA AE, no construction).
